ServiceApplicationClient prepare_request_body fails with NameError

#### Description

When using ServiceApplicationClient to prepare a request body for JWT assertion, the method fails with a NameError because the `assertion` variable is referenced before being defined.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.oauth2 import ServiceApplicationClient

# Set up client with private key
client_id = 'your_client_id'
private_key = """-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
... your private key here ...
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----"""

client = ServiceApplicationClient(client_id, private_key=private_key)

# Try to prepare request body
body = client.prepare_request_body(
    issuer='https://example.com',
    subject='user@example.com', 
    audience='https://oauth.example.com/token',
    body='grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer'
)
```

This raises:
```
NameError: name 'assertion' is not defined
```

The issue occurs because the JWT encoding line was removed but the code still tries to use the `assertion` variable that was never created.
</issue>
